description: Pairwise model selection on long finance workflows with an adequate budget; approved.

request.intent: Compare two local agents on long, multi-step finance workflows and tell me which is better.

criteria.purpose: Detect a meaningful difference in effect pass rate between the two agents.
criteria.estimand: paired difference in trace-effect pass rate
criteria.null_hypothesis: the two agents have equal effect pass rate on this distribution
criteria.alternative_hypothesis: the two agents differ in effect pass rate
criteria.decision_rule: reject the null if the paired bootstrap CI for the delta excludes 0
criteria.allowed_claim: agent A differs from agent B on the planned task distribution
failure_modes: underpowered if task_budget is too small
biased if task mix is skewed
criteria.selection_rationale: the primary question compares two agents on the same planned distribution, so paired task-level resampling is the planned comparison family
